# ENSO Japanese Cuisine

> > ENSO Japanese Cuisine offers authentic Japanese cooking ingredients, meal kits, and recipes for home preparation of traditional dishes like sushi, ramen, tonkatsu, and yakitori.

ENSO specializes in Japanese pantry essentials including panko breadcrumbs, wasabi, nori seaweed, yakitori sauce, and complete cooking kits. The site features recipes, cultural guides, and products for making traditional Japanese meals at home, with content available in English, French, and Italian.

## Key Topics

- ENSO Japanese Cuisine
- Panko breadcrumbs
- Sushi making
- Bento boxes
- Wasabi and Wasabia japonica
- Tonkatsu
- Katsudon
- Yakitori sauce
- Tempura
- Ramen noodles
- Japanese condiments
- Mirin
- Nori seaweed
- Traditional Japanese recipes
- Home cooking kits

## Product Catalog

- [Sushi Kit 325g](https://www.enso.jp/products/sushi-kit-325g): Complete sushi kit with rice, vinegar, soy sauce, and nori for 25 maki
- [Yakitori sauce 150ml](https://www.enso.jp/products/yakitori-sauce-150ml): Yakitori sauce for grilled chicken skewers: marinade and dipping sauce
- [Wasabi paste 30g](https://www.enso.jp/products/wasabi-paste-30g): Wasabi paste in 6g sachets: horseradish-based sushi condiment
- [Ramen Noodles 100g (French)](https://www.enso.jp/fr/products/ramen-noodles-100g): French product: Quick-cooking ramen noodles for soup and yakisoba
- [Breadcrumbs Panko (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/products/breadcrumbs-panko): Italian product: Japanese panko breadcrumbs for Tonkatsu coating
- [Sushi Nori roasted seaweed 11g (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/products/sushi-nori-roasted-seaweed-11g): Italian product: Roasted nori seaweed sheets for maki sushi (4 sheets)
- [Ponzu sauce 150ml (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/products/ponzu-sauce-150ml): Italian product: Ponzu citrus-soy sauce with lime juice and bonito
- [Yakitori sauce 150ml (French)](https://www.enso.jp/fr/products/yakitori-sauce-150ml): French product: Yakitori marinade and dipping sauce with soy base

- [COOKING KITS (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/collections/cooking-kits): Italian collection: Sushi, tempura, ramen, yakisoba, and karaage kits

## Japanese Food Culture & Ingredients

- [What is inside a Japanese bento box?](https://www.enso.jp/blogs/news/what-is-inside-a-japanese-bento-box): Explains 400-year history of bento boxes and traditional Japanese lunch culture
- [What is wasabi? Everything you should know](https://www.enso.jp/blogs/news/what-is-wasabi-heres-everything-you-should-know): Guide to wasabi: Wasabia japonica plant, history, and horseradish substitutes
- [How to easily make Maki at home](https://www.enso.jp/blogs/news/how-to-easily-make-maki-at-home): Tutorial for making maki sushi rolls at home with nori and rice
- [Japanese street food (French)](https://www.enso.jp/fr/blogs/news/the-best-mouthwatering-japanese-street-food): French article on Japanese yatai street food culture: takoyaki, yakisoba
- [Cooking with Japanese panko breadcrumbs (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/blogs/news/cooking-with-japanese-panko-breadcrumbs): Italian guide to using panko for Tonkatsu, Ebi Furai, and Korokke dishes

## Recipe Guides

- [Katsudon](https://www.enso.jp/blogs/recipes/katsudon): Recipe for Katsudon with panko-breaded chicken, eggs, and sushi rice
- [Tonkatsu (French)](https://www.enso.jp/fr/blogs/recipes/tonkatsu): French recipe: Tonkatsu pork cutlet with panko breadcrumbs and sauce
- [Katsudon (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/blogs/recipes/katsudon): Italian version: Katsudon recipe with panko, mirin, and chicken breast

## Optional - International Content

- [What is inside a Japanese bento box? (Italian)](https://www.enso.jp/it/blogs/news/what-is-inside-a-japanese-bento-box): Italian version: Bento box history with Tamagoyaki and Umeboshi details
- [What is wasabi? (French)](https://www.enso.jp/fr/blogs/news/what-is-wasabi-heres-everything-you-should-know): French guide: Wasabia japonica plant, Edo period history, and usage
